summary: Frontend testing for PulseFitness.ai Customer Deliveries tab feature. Verified: (1) ops dealer pack modal has 'Customer's Pulse account' row with link/change/unlink/search flow working; (2) Pulse operator (lite.docs@pulsedemo.test) sees a 'Deliveries' tab appended at the END of dashboard tab bar; (3) Deliveries tab shows 2 items (Elite Treadmill Runner 9000 - Installed + certificate + warranty, Spin Bike Pro 500 - Scheduled, no cert); (4) certificate button opens a new tab with authenticated PDF fetch (200 OK); (5) other tabs (Equipment, Faults, Documents) still work. All acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: InvAllocation.js: the 'Unlink' button (data-testid=inv-pulse-unlink) is only rendered inside the expanded search panel (when toggle is 'Change'). This is fine but a minor UX nit — after selecting an option the panel collapses so the unlink is hidden. Acceptable per test spec since the requirement is that unlink is reachable via 'Change' -> 'Unlink', which works.
